definition: A stream of the Temporary Foreign Worker Program for employers hiring highly skilled workers in select occupations, with the fastest published Labour Market Impact Assessment service standard: 10 business days for 80% of applications.
longform: It is the one part of the LMIA system with a fixed, published turnaround, which is why it is often the fastest route to an employer-sponsored work permit for the occupations it covers.
